note: Six positions: human understanding cannot be automated, researchers using AI remain responsible for correctness and attribution, and journals need binding disclosure rules. It also calls for adapted teaching, support for early-career researchers, and publicly funded research with free AI systems independent of large tech companies.
title: Positionen des Präsidiums der Deutschen Mathematiker-Vereinigung (DMV) zur Bedeutung Künstlicher Intelligenz für die Mathematik
who: Presidium of the German Mathematical Society (DMV)
